context:
Goal: a reviewer FAIL round is never lost.
Problem (rule): lane R67-drain's PR #3222 (rebuild of #1760) makes the record path run lane lint first and refuse when it is red. A FAIL round on a lint-red head therefore cannot be recorded, so the round count never sees it (merge.py line 5776, the lane's reading). Your rule says a change gets at most three review rounds; a lost FAIL round breaks that count.
Based on (read): the lane's hand-in message 14:30 CST Nov 13; triage has not read merge.py or #3222. Past rulings: none found in roadmap/rulings for a FAIL-only record.
Departs from: main — main prints a FAIL record with no lint (lane's words); option b keeps that for FAIL only, option a drops it.
Meanwhile: nothing changes; #3222 is handed in as built. The lane's candidate debt (no check refuses a push after a FAIL round with no record for that head) is filed as step fail-round-needs-record-before-push.

lastAnswer.label: B: Allow a FAIL-only record without the lint

options.gain: One rule for every record; no second path.
options.label: Accept it: the lint always runs first, so a FAIL round on a lint-red head is not recorded (Recommended)
options.lose: That round is unrecorded and the round count misses it; the new step's push check is the cover.

options.label: Allow a FAIL-only record without the lint
options.lose: A second path prints a record, which widens the shared tool. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

reply: Filed as ruling own-764-b-fail-only-record: a FAIL-only record is allowed without lane lint; a PASS or mixed record still runs it first. Sent to lane R67-drain to build into #3222 (red case first, reviewer).
short: Record a FAIL round on a lint-red head?
title: Should a reviewer FAIL round on a lint-red head be recordable without the lint?
why: Option b adds a second record path to the shared merge tool; option a leaves that round uncounted.
